CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: CI: 2 additional compressed Construct artifacts (PARENA_CONSTRUCT.tar.gz, PARENA_CONSTRUCT.zip) alongside the existing raw .txt, and the Construct file is now bundled into every real client release build (Linux/macOS tar.gz, Windows zip) so a downloaded build can be traced back to its exact source snapshot. Verified live against the real v0.97.0 release. PARENA commit c6411e2, Apple #16423. session: sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
